note: Thresholds and legal references are data. New-Act numbers 185/186/188 and 33 per incometaxindia.gov.in section pages and TaxTMI; the provision corresponding to s.40A(3)/43(1) is not yet confirmed.

TB_UNBALANCED.title: Trial balance does not tally
TB_UNBALANCED.simple: Total debits and total credits are not equal.

OPENING_TOTAL_DIFF.title: Difference in opening balances
OPENING_TOTAL_DIFF.simple: Opening debits and credits of this year are not equal.

OPENING_DIFF.title: Opening balance differs from last year's closing
OPENING_DIFF.simple: This ledger's opening this year does not match its closing last year.

OPENING_MISSING_LEDGER.title: Last year's ledger missing this year
OPENING_MISSING_LEDGER.simple: A ledger had a closing balance last year but is not in this year's books.

OPENING_NEW_LEDGER.title: New ledger with opening balance
OPENING_NEW_LEDGER.simple: A ledger has an opening balance but did not exist last year.

PL_OPENING.title: Income/expense ledger has an opening balance
PL_OPENING.simple: Income and expense ledgers must start the year at zero.

UNKNOWN_GROUP.title: Group not recognised
UNKNOWN_GROUP.simple: This ledger's group could not be linked to a standard group. Tell LedgerCraft the parent group once.

UNMAPPED.title: Ledger not mapped
UNMAPPED.simple: This ledger has no place in the financial statements yet.

VOUCHER_UNBALANCED.title: Voucher debit and credit differ
VOUCHER_UNBALANCED.simple: This voucher's debits and credits are not equal.

VOUCHER_UNKNOWN_LEDGER.title: Voucher uses a ledger not in the trial balance
VOUCHER_UNKNOWN_LEDGER.simple: A voucher refers to a ledger that is missing from the trial balance.

VOUCHER_TB_MISMATCH.title: Vouchers do not add up to trial balance
VOUCHER_TB_MISMATCH.simple: Opening + all vouchers does not equal the closing balance of this ledger.

VOUCHER_OUTSIDE_PERIOD.title: Voucher dated outside the financial year
VOUCHER_OUTSIDE_PERIOD.simple: This voucher's date is outside the year being prepared.

DUPLICATE_VOUCHER.title: Possible duplicate voucher
DUPLICATE_VOUCHER.simple: Two vouchers have the same date, ledgers and amounts.

NEGATIVE_CASH.title: Cash balance negative
NEGATIVE_CASH.simple: Cash in hand went below zero at the end of this day, which is not possible in reality.

CASH_CR_BALANCE.title: Cash in hand has credit balance
CASH_CR_BALANCE.simple: Cash in hand cannot be negative at year end.

SUSPENSE_BALANCE.title: Suspense account has a balance
SUSPENSE_BALANCE.simple: Suspense must be cleared before finalising.

ABNORMAL_BALANCE.title: Unusual balance side
ABNORMAL_BALANCE.simple: This ledger normally has the opposite balance.

RECLASS_DEBTOR_CR.title: Customer credit balance shown as liability
RECLASS_DEBTOR_CR.simple: Customer has paid in advance; shown under Other Current Liabilities (advance from customers).
RECLASS_DEBTOR_CR.old_ref: Schedule III / ICAI GN: no netting of assets and liabilities
RECLASS_DEBTOR_CR.new_ref: Schedule III / ICAI GN: no netting of assets and liabilities

RECLASS_CREDITOR_DR.title: Supplier debit balance shown as asset
RECLASS_CREDITOR_DR.simple: Supplier has been paid in advance; shown under Short-term Loans and Advances.
RECLASS_CREDITOR_DR.old_ref: Schedule III / ICAI GN: no netting of assets and liabilities
RECLASS_CREDITOR_DR.new_ref: Schedule III / ICAI GN: no netting of assets and liabilities

RECLASS_BANK_CR.title: Bank credit balance shown as borrowing
RECLASS_BANK_CR.simple: Bank account is overdrawn; shown under Short-term Borrowings.

MISGROUP_LOAN.title: Loan grouped as creditor/debtor
MISGROUP_LOAN.simple: This looks like a loan but is grouped as a party. Loans go under Borrowings, and cash loan limits apply.
MISGROUP_LOAN.new_ref: Schedule III; Income-tax Act 2025, ss.185/188 (correspond to s.269SS/269T)

MISGROUP_OD.title: Overdraft / cash credit grouped as bank account
MISGROUP_OD.simple: Overdraft and cash credit accounts are borrowings, not bank balances.

MISGROUP_TAX.title: Tax ledger grouped as creditor
MISGROUP_TAX.simple: GST/TDS ledgers belong under Duties & Taxes (statutory dues), not trade creditors.

CAPITAL_IN_EXPENSE.title: Possible capital item in expenses
CAPITAL_IN_EXPENSE.simple: This expense ledger name suggests an asset purchase. Check whether it should be capitalised.

MISC_EXP_ASSET.title: Miscellaneous expenditure carried as asset
MISC_EXP_ASSET.simple: Preliminary/deferred expenses generally cannot be carried as assets under AS 26.

CASH_PAYMENT_LIMIT.title: Cash payment above limit
CASH_PAYMENT_LIMIT.simple: Cash paid for an expense/purchase to one person in a day is above the limit. The expense may be disallowed.
CASH_PAYMENT_LIMIT.new_ref: IT Act 2025 provision corresponding to s.40A(3) (section no. to be confirmed)

CASH_ASSET_PURCHASE.title: Asset bought in cash above limit
CASH_ASSET_PURCHASE.simple: Asset bought in cash above the limit; that amount is not counted in tax depreciation.
CASH_ASSET_PURCHASE.new_ref: IT Act 2025 provision corresponding to s.43(1) (section no. to be confirmed)

CASH_RECEIPT_LIMIT.title: Cash received ₹2 lakh or more
CASH_RECEIPT_LIMIT.simple: Cash of ₹2 lakh or more received from one person in a day / one transaction. Penalty may apply.

LOAN_ACCEPTED_CASH.title: Loan accepted in cash (limit test)
LOAN_ACCEPTED_CASH.simple: Loan taken in cash where the loan (with earlier unpaid principal) is ₹20,000 or more.

LOAN_ACCEPTED_JOURNAL.title: Loan accepted by journal entry
LOAN_ACCEPTED_JOURNAL.simple: Loan credited through a journal (not bank or cash). Check the mode; book adjustments may count as 'otherwise than banking channel'.

LOAN_REPAID_CASH.title: Loan repaid in cash (limit test)
LOAN_REPAID_CASH.simple: Loan repaid in cash where the amount, or the balance with interest, is ₹20,000 or more.

STATEMENT_NOT_BALANCED.title: Balance Sheet does not tally
STATEMENT_NOT_BALANCED.simple: Total assets and total liabilities are not equal after mapping.

FAR_TB_MISMATCH.title: Fixed asset register does not match books
FAR_TB_MISMATCH.simple: Net block of this ledger as per the fixed asset register differs from the trial balance.

FAR_DEP_MISMATCH.title: Depreciation in books differs from register
FAR_DEP_MISMATCH.simple: Depreciation charged in the books is not equal to depreciation worked out in the fixed asset register.

FAR_MISSING_LEDGER.title: Fixed asset ledger not in register
FAR_MISSING_LEDGER.simple: This fixed asset ledger has a balance but no asset in the fixed asset register.

FAR_ERROR.title: Fixed asset register entry not understood
FAR_ERROR.simple: An asset in the register has an unknown class / block.
